title: Director of Sales Marketing
description:
**Company Description** 
 Merlis Hotels Coimbatore is a hospitality provider focused on delivering comfortable stays and quality service to business and leisure travelers. The hotel is located in Coimbatore, a growing commercial hub that attracts corporate guests and tourists throughout the year. Merlis Hotels emphasizes guest satisfaction, operational efficiency, and consistent service standards. The team works collaboratively to create welcoming experiences and build long\-term relationships with guests. The organization values professional growth, performance, and integrity in all aspects of its operations.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Director of Sales Marketing role based at Merlis Hotels in Coimbatore. The Director of Sales Marketing leads the sales and marketing function, develops and executes strategies to increase room revenue, banquet and event bookings, and corporate contracts. Daily responsibilities include managing key accounts, identifying new business opportunities, overseeing sales operations, and ensuring effective coordination between sales, front office, and reservations teams. The role involves designing and implementing marketing campaigns, monitoring online presence, collaborating with distribution partners, and analyzing market trends and competitor activity. The Director is also responsible for setting targets, mentoring the sales team, reviewing performance, preparing regular reports for management, and ensuring high standards of customer service and brand representation.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong Sales and Business Development skills, with experience in identifying opportunities, managing pipelines, and closing deals in the hospitality or service sector.
* Proficiency in Sales Operations, including forecasting, reporting, pricing strategies, and coordination with revenue management.
* Demonstrated Customer Service capabilities, with a focus on building long\-term client relationships and managing key accounts.
* Proven Team Management experience, including setting objectives, coaching team members, and driving performance in a sales environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality Management, or a related field; an MBA or advanced diploma in hospitality or marketing is an advantage.
* Experience in hotel sales and marketing, corporate contracting, and event or MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) sales preferred.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to work with targets and deadlines.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, hotel sales systems, and MS Office; familiarity with digital marketing channels and OTA management is beneficial.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and external partners.
* Tamil known candidates preferred.

title: Junior Marketing
description:
**Company Description** 
 Kannan Tools and Dies is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001 certified manufacturer serving engineering and manufacturing industries since 2000\. Based in Coimbatore, the company is a leading producer and exporter of precision machined components and sub\-assemblies for sectors such as defense, aerospace, space technology, healthcare, heavy engineering, energy, oil and gas, railways, and wind energy. The organization specializes in CNC precision machining and fabrication using a wide range of materials, including titanium alloys, Inconel, nickel alloys, stainless steel, aluminum alloys, duplex and super duplex steels, and other advanced alloys. Kannan Tools and Dies is known for prototype development, reverse engineering, and expertise in machining exotic materials, supported by an R\&D partnership with Kumaraguru College of Technology. The company is actively involved in upcoming projects related to missile systems, aerospace, defense, nuclear programs, and marine applications.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time Junior Marketing role is an on\-site position based in Coimbatore. The Junior Marketing team member will support the development and execution of marketing activities to promote precision machined components and engineering solutions across domestic and international markets. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include assisting with market research, preparing marketing materials, coordinating with the sales team on lead generation and follow\-ups, and maintaining customer and prospect databases. The role involves supporting customer communication, participating in customer visits or calls with senior team members, collecting feedback, and helping prepare reports and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. The Junior Marketing professional will also contribute to basic digital and offline marketing initiatives, support trade show or event preparations, and collaborate with technical teams to understand products and translate them into clear marketing messages.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with customers, internal teams, and external partners.
* Candidates should possess Market Research and Marketing Strategy skills to analyze industry trends, identify opportunities, and support planning of promotional activities.
* Candidates should possess foundational Sales skills to assist with lead generation, follow\-ups, and coordination between marketing and sales functions.
* Candidates should ideally have basic knowledge of digital and offline marketing tools, including presentations, brochures, email campaigns, and social media.
* Candidates should have good analytical and organizational abilities, attention to detail, and proficiency with common office software (e.g., MS Office, spreadsheets, presentations).
* A diploma or bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field is preferred; interest in manufacturing, aerospace, or defense sectors will be an advantage.
* Ability to learn technical product information quickly, work collaboratively in a team environment, and manage tasks within timelines is essential.

title: Influencer Marketing Intern(Unpaid Internship)
description:
**Company Description** 
 Zettx is a fast\-growing startup focused on redefining influencer marketing through personalized, high\-impact strategies. The team collaborates with over 12,000 creators and has partnered with more than 60 brands across beauty, wellness, and lifestyle, including Tru Hair \& Skin, Chemist at Play, Sunscoop, Bare Anatomy, and Mcaffeine. Rather than chasing scale, Zettx prioritizes measurable results, agile execution, and smarter campaign strategy. The company specializes in influencer marketing, YouTube advertising, and social media growth, turning attention into trust and trust into revenue. Guided by a vision to be the most trusted influencer marketing ecosystem, Zettx aims to build lasting brand legacies through real influence and consistent growth.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Influencer Marketing Intern role is a full\-time, remote position supporting the end\-to\-end execution of creator and influencer campaigns. On a day\-to\-day basis, the intern will help identify and research potential influencers, manage outreach, and coordinate communication with creators across multiple platforms. The role involves assisting with campaign planning, tracking deliverables, monitoring performance metrics, and preparing reports for internal teams and clients. The intern will support content briefing, timeline management, and quality checks to ensure brand guidelines are met. This position offers exposure to data\-driven influencer strategies, social media trends, and cross\-functional collaboration with marketing and account management teams.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong interest in influencer marketing, social media trends, and digital\-first brands; familiarity with platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.
* Basic skills in campaign coordination and communication, including influencer outreach, follow\-ups, and relationship management.
* Foundational research and analytical abilities to identify suitable creators, assess audience fit, and support performance tracking.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for drafting briefs, emails, and internal updates; attention to detail in reviewing content.
* Organizational and time\-management skills to handle multiple campaigns, deadlines, and remote collaboration tools.
* Comfort with spreadsheets and presentation tools (e.g., Google Workspace or Microsoft Office); exposure to analytics or CRM tools is a plus.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, take initiative, and learn quickly in a fast\-paced startup setting.
* Relevant coursework or projects in marketing, communications, media, or related fields; prior internship or project experience in digital or social media marketing is an advantage but not required.

title: Junior SEO Analyst
description:
**Role summary** 





 You will execute the monthly SEO activities for assigned Amber Group brand websites under the SEO Lead's direction, creating optimized content, implementing on\-page elements, building quality backlinks, and keeping our SEO documentation accurate. This role is the execution engine of the SEO team and a structured growth path into advanced SEO, AEO and AI\-search (GEO) work.
 




**Key responsibilities** 



* Write and publish SEO\-optimized blog content using AI every month; refresh and improve existing content.
* Implement on\-page SEO elements: meta titles, meta descriptions, heading structure, image alt text, internal links, canonical tags and XML sitemaps (schema markup with guidance).
* Off\-page SEO: quality link building, social bookmarking, directory submissions, business listings, citations and guest\-posting support, with every link tracked and verified.
* Publish content in the CMS with a pre\-publish SEO checklist (metas, links, images, schema).
* Monitor Google Search Console for indexing issues and broken links; escalate technical issues to the SEO Lead.
* Maintain the keyword, content and backlink trackers accurately and daily.
* Provide weekly reporting inputs from Search Console and GA4\.
* Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude etc.) responsibly for research and drafts, always fact\-checked and human\-edited before publishing.



**Required skills \& experience** 



* 1–2 years of hands\-on SEO experience (agency or in\-house).
* Working knowledge of Google Search Console and GA4; exposure to Semrush, Screaming Frog.
* Solid grasp of on\-page and off\-page fundamentals; basic HTML familiarity.
* Hands\-on familiarity with AI tools for content and research workflows.
* A self\-driven learner: this role comes with a structured 13\-week learning plan across SEO, AEO, GEO, AIO and AXO, and we expect genuine ownership of it.



  





**Nice to have** 



* CMS experience.
* Basic schema/structured\-data knowledge (FAQ, Article).
* Awareness of AEO/GEO, how content gets cited by AI engines.



**What you get** 





 Exposure to 15\+ live websites across industries, a defined learning path with weekly mentoring from the SEO Lead, and hands\-on work in AI\-search optimization, the fastest\-growing area of the field.
